hooks.name: bell_ring
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's BellRingEvent)

doc_summary: A bell is about to ring: `native_bell_ring(dimension, player, pos, cancel)` is asked before the bell event and sound. Set `cancel` to stop the ring and its raider reveal. `player` is the acting server player when available. Bundles need "hooks": @API:bell_ring@.
